entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-qqmf-gpg7-g8gw: PyTorch Lightning allows arbitrary code execution through checkpoint _instantiator hyperparameters
entry.content:
PyTorch Lightning allows arbitrary code execution through checkpoint _instantiator hyperparameters

Aliases: CVE-2026-58659, PYSEC-2026-3624, PYSEC-2026-3967

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H · CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:A/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • lightning — fixed in 2.6.6

PyTorch Lightning through 2.6.5, fixed in commit d710d68, contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the _load_state function that imports and executes attacker-controlled module names from checkpoint _instantiator hyperparameters. Attackers can craft malicious checkpoint files that bypass weights_only=True protections to execute arbitrary code when LightningModule.load_from_checkpoint is called.

Affected:

### Impact An issue was discovered in psd-tools before 1.9.4.
